note: Cumberland County KY: no queryable zoning district service found. The only zoning published is a PDF map of the City of Burkesville (Burkesville Planning Commission, rev. 2018) and a PDF/resource-page zoning map for an industrial park. The Hub dataset 'Cumberland County Zoning' (CumberlandGIS) is Cumberland County, North Carolina, not Kentucky. The KyGovMaps portal and KY county service catalog list no Cumberland KY zoning service. Parcel data is only commercial (Dynamo, Acres) or PVA tax maps.
